files.description: The complete EHI export documentation: a 4-page PDF describing the export as a ZIP per patient containing a C-CDA XML file, a documents folder with attached files, and a Patient Documents Detail.xls. No data dictionary or field-level documentation. Version 1.0, created 2023-11-22.
Screenshot of the Data Export landing page showing a single bullet-pointed link to the EHI export PDF. No other content on the page.
